notes:
Quick notes from discovery: 
- SMB inbound via signup + demo request. self-serve first, wants to keep hosted API (public cloud). 
- Primary product: customer support chat bot + knowledge search (doc-search for KB). plan to add autogenerated summaries for long threads. 
- Cost sensitivity: leadership target = <= $3k/month as they scale initial pilot (1000 weekly chats). engineering willing to trade-off latency for cost but want 95th pct latency < 600ms on short queries. 
- Main asks: batching recommendations, prefix/KV caching strategy, prompt compression best-practices, token usage audit of their exported logs. asked for example config they can copy into prod. 
- Model prefs: open to gpt-style models; prefer smaller generation tails, token trimming. wants routing fallback to cheaper model during spikes. 
- Security: SOC2 required for vendor onboarding, SSO (SAML) later, audit logs + retention policy (90 days) needed for initial contract. data residency not strict (NA ok). 
- Quote from CEO: "We signed up because onboarding was fast. main blocker is uncertainty on monthly bill once traffic grows." 
- Internal stakeholders: CEO (decision), Head of Product (owner of pilot), 2 engineers (implementers), finance reviewing ARR impact. 
- POC idea: 2-week pilot using hosted API + automated batching config, measure tokens/month and latency. if token audit shows >30% savings with batching and prompt compression, move to paid pilot. 
- Risks: their prompts include long system messages and verbose context; will need help compressing. engineering bandwidth limited until mid-March. 
- Good candidate for Redwood Optimize recommendations + quick wins: batching, prefix caching, compressive prompt templates.
